notes.title: Ver 1.0.7 Update
notes.content:
1. Several SMI files have fixed bugs that do not function properly.
2.The mouse cursor display bug has been modified.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
[b]1.Added mouse input.[/b]

You can click the UI button using the mouse.

Reset the right mouse button to the position.


(When using dual monitor, the mouse cursor is out of screen.
We recommend using single monitor settings.)

notes.title: Ver 1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
1. Supports URL streaming

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34830441/36296675c3c205f2092fdc4aa65fc7cc8a4edbc4.jpg[/img]

Below are the supported URLs.

http: //
httpd: //
https: //
mms: //
rtsp: //
rtspt: //
rtspu: //

To use, copy the URL address (Ctrl + c) and click the Paste button.
Click the Open url button to play the video.

2. Added the ability to delete from the recent playlist and bookmark

3. Fixed a bug where other subtitles would still be displayed when the file was opened.

Thank you.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
1. The aspect ratio will now change automatically depending on the media.

2. A reverb function has been added to the sound equalizer.

3. Stereoscopic image can be adjusted horizontally (Horizontal Image Translation) has been added.


Thank you.

notes.title: Ver 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
[b] 1. Supports SMI caption format. [/ B]
SMI subtitles are mainly used in Korea.
(cautions)
If the folder path and file name are not English, the subtitle file can not be read. Always run in English.

If the name of the subtitle file is the same as the name of the media file, the subtitle is recognized automatically.

When a subtitle file is run, it automatically plays the media if there is a media file with the same name.

[b] 2. Added location reset button to main panel [/ b]

[b] 3. Improved folder favorites in File Explorer [/ b]
The icon of the folder is changed when the input is selected.

[b] 4. Added repeatable option for media. [/ b]

[b] 5. ​​Added new mini info window [/ b]
If there is an input, it shows the information about the playback position of the media and the size of the sound.

Thank you.

notes.title: 1.0.2.1 Update
notes.content:
[b]1.The mkv file is now played by Vlc Player.[/b]

Previous versions of .mkv were played with Windows Media Player.

However, there were compatibility problems with various video formats.

To resolve compatibility issues, the .mkv file is now played by the VLC Player.

VLC Player does not support hardware acceleration.

The .mkv file can cause problems at resolutions over 4k.

.mkv files are recommended for movie of 2k or less.

[b]2. Add copyright notice page.[/b]

Added copyright notice page in option window.

  Thank you.

notes.title: 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
[b]1. .MKV bug fix[/b]
Problems with some mkv files not opening
The mkv file is unstable.
If the mkv file cannot be played, I recommend you to convert it to .mp4 h24 and run it.

[b]2. VR controller bug fix[/b]
Problems with only the right controller operating and not working properly when running

[b]3. Steam achievements bug fix[/b]
Fix a problem that didn't recognize the achievement

Sorry for the inconvenience.
Please let me know if you have any problems. I'll fix it as soon as you.
